01

Logo

How to use our logo so it always looks right.

Primary logo

This is our main logo. Use it first, wherever you can.

It's the letters n and c drawn as one line, with the n flowing straight into the c.

The small point at the top always points up.

Logo variations

When people might not know us yet, use a version that shows our name. Don't go smaller than the sizes listed. Below that, the name gets hard to read, so use the main logo instead.

Primary logo

Use it first, everywhere. Merch, profile pictures, stickers.

Print 10 mm and up · Web 24 px and up

Stacked logo

Posters, signs, the first page of a presentation.

Print 25 mm and up · Web 120 px and up

Horizontal logo

Wide, short spaces. Website header, email signature, letterhead.

Print 38 mm and up · Web 160 px and up

Logo colors

Blue and cream are the everyday versions. Black and white are only for black-and-white printing and websites. The number shows how well the logo stands out from its background.

Blue on cream8.1 : 1
Cream on blue8.1 : 1
Black on white20.1 : 1 · B&W and web only
White on black20.1 : 1 · B&W and web only

Safe space

Always leave white space around the logo. Don't let text, pictures or the edge of the page get too close. The shaded area shows the space to keep clear.

Wrong usage

Never do any of these. The same rules apply to every version of the logo.

1
Don't stretch or squash it
2
Don't rotate it
3
Don't change its colors
4
Don't add shadows or outlines
5
Don't put it where it's hard to see
6
Don't move the parts around

How much of each

A rough guide for any layout. Keep red small, like a line, a button or one highlighted word.

Blue 60%
Cream 35%

Last part: red, 5%.

Logo on backgrounds

Always check the contrast before you put the logo on a background. A free tool like the WebAIM Contrast Checker gives you the number in seconds.

4.5 : 1 or higherThe WCAG AA standard. Anything lower is too hard to see.

Do

8.1 : 1Blue on cream
8.1 : 1Cream on blue
20.1 : 1Black on white
B&W / web only
20.1 : 1White on black
B&W / web only

Don't

1.8 : 1Blue on red
2.3 : 1Blue on black
1.1 : 1Cream on white
Not allowedRed logo

05

Merch

T-shirts and hoodies only ever show the logo. No name, no slogans, nothing else.

Any color works, if the logo is easy to see

Pick any shirt or hoodie color. Then print the logo in blue or cream, whichever stands out more. Check the contrast first: it must be 4.5 : 1 or higher (WCAG AA).

Blue hoodieCream logo · 8.1 : 1
Cream teeBlue logo · 8.1 : 1
Forest green hoodieCream logo · 6.6 : 1
Heather grey teeBlue logo, left chest · 4.8 : 1
